name: dev.zevium/mcp
title: Zevium
description: Search a pay-per-call API marketplace, read endpoint docs and prices, and call APIs with credits.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Zevium API key from https://www.zevium.dev/app/settings/keys. Not needed if your client connects with OAuth; otherwise required for call_api_read/call_api_write.

tools.name: search_apis
tools.description: Search the public API catalogue with per-endpoint pricing.

tools.name: get_api_docs
tools.description: Read endpoint definitions, prices and usage notes for one API.

tools.name: call_api_read
tools.description: Call a GET or HEAD endpoint through the metered gateway using prepaid org credits.

tools.name: call_api_write
tools.description: Call a POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE, OPTIONS or TRACE endpoint; may change upstream data. Uses prepaid org credits.

dev.zevium.billing: Prepaid org-scoped credits; zero balance blocks the call.
dev.zevium.auth: OAuth on /mcp (first connect auto-creates the member's MCP key) or an Authorization: Bearer API key header; tools take no key argument.
